tagline: The global travel marketplace connecting travelers, partners, and advertisers to shape the future of travel through trusted brands, technology, and first-party data.
hero_kpi_rationale: Lodging revenue represents 80% of total revenue, making it the primary driver of the company, driven by room night growth and Vrbo expansion in vacation rental bookings.

kpis.name: Lodging revenue share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue derived from lodging reservations (hotels and rentals).
kpis.description: Lodging represents the vast majority of revenues, with sustained growth in room nights booked (+8% in 2025).
kpis.signal: Lodging: central pillar of business model

kpis.name: Room nights booked growth
kpis.explanation: Change in total number of lodging room nights booked through the platform.
kpis.description: Room nights increased 8% in 2025 versus +9% in 2024, reflecting improving demand in the second half of the year.

kpis.name: Average daily rate change
kpis.explanation: Change in average price per room night booked.
kpis.description: Average daily rate increased 1% in 2025, following a 1% decline in 2024, supported by recovering demand.

kpis.name: Total advertising revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from advertising on Expedia and trivago sites and apps.
kpis.description: Total advertising revenue reached $1.175B in 2025 ($758M direct + $417M via trivago), up 19%.

kpis.name: Air ticket bookings growth
kpis.explanation: Change in number of flight tickets booked through the platform.
kpis.description: Air bookings increased 3% in 2025 versus +6% in 2024, with improvement in year-end.

kpis.name: Total lodging properties available
kpis.explanation: Total number of lodging properties (hotels and alternatives) accessible on the platform.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, Expedia offered 3.6 million properties, including 2.4 million via Vrbo.
kpis.signal: Among the most extensive lodging inventory platforms

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets sourced from yfinance over the last four fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €24.45B in the last fiscal year

kpis.name: Total debt
kpis.description: Total debt sourced from yfinance over the last four fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €6.42B in the last fiscal year

kpis.name: Dividends per share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share distributed, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years declared by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividends per share of $0.48 in the last fiscal year

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders through annual dividends, sourced from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years declared.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.2B in the last fiscal year

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 15.5% in the last fiscal year

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last seven fiscal years 10-K filings declared.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $14.733B in the last fiscal year

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight fiscal years 10-K filings declared.
kpis.signal: Net income of $1.294B in the last fiscal year

kpis.name: Advertising revenue growth
kpis.explanation: Annual change in total advertising revenue (direct + trivago).
kpis.description: Advertising revenue increased 19% in 2025, driven by trivago recovery (+33%) and organic growth.

kpis.name: trivago third-party revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by trivago from external advertising partners.
kpis.description: In 2025, trivago generated $417M in third-party revenue, up 33%, following a strategic marketing overhaul.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance risk
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the first section of Item 1A with strong language ('adversely affect our business, financial performance'). It concerns laws and regulations in constant evolution, increasing exposure. The Regulation category has high weighting in the technology sector.

risks.title: Tax risk exposure
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly cites risks related to tax interpretations, changes in tax rates and new legislation. The context of aggressive tax authorities and new taxes (digital services taxes) strengthens severity. The language is repeated and detailed.

ai_positioning.summary: Expedia acknowledges that technological developments in generative AI are increasingly being used to create competing offerings, including AI-powered digital planning and assistance tools, further intensifying competition. The company does not detail its own internal AI initiatives.
evidence: Technological developments in generative AI tools are increasingly being used to create competing offerings, such as AI powered digital planning and assistance, further increasing competition.
